fishing: WHEN: Wednesday dawn Oct 7. Charlotte Harbor low 3:09a, high 9:46a, low 4:51p, high 11:39p. Best bite about 6:54a-8:54a before storms. S-SW 5-10 kt, light chop, rain about 88%, numerous afternoon storms — run the pass early. Lemon Bay solunar average; major about 9:05a-11:05a. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks 9/11 still the last pass note — mangrove snapper and pompano at trestles and bridges, mostly small snook, a few 50-100 lb tarpon at Gasparilla Pass. Recent guide notes (week of Sep 29) have redfish schools thick and snook mixed on the beach and flats. LEMON BAY: Fishin Franks 9/25 smaller black drum and big redfish under the docks, pompano in the pass, trout and juvenile gags on the flats. 9/18 schools of reds from the Miserable Mile to the Tom Adams Bridge, snook in the ICW, mangrove snapper at Chadwick Park pier. NEARSHORE: Fall school bite; guides reporting redfish and snook on the flats, some sharks as water cools. Capt. Mike / Manasota Key Outfitters last posted report is still June (summer tarpon); no October bite note. Baits: live shrimp, cut bait, pinfish, gold spoons.
redtide: FWC Oct 2: K. brevis background only in SWFL (Sarasota samples); Charlotte Harbor samples through Oct 5 background, none detected. No fish kills. Next report Oct 9.
bacteria: Manasota Key Beach GOOD, no advisory — enterococci 10 on 9/28 (Healthy Beaches, page updated 10/6). Englewood Beach GOOD, last listed 20 CFU on 9/21, no advisory.
fpl: Morning check: Charlotte 2 / Sarasota 149 customers out; no Englewood/Manasota spike noted.
